text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 1, 2024) for 1705 Bathurst Street.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 1, 2024) for 1705 Bathurst Street, Folder Number 24 191179 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to November 30, 2024 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
